targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, payload->>'profile' AS perfil, payload->>'state' AS estado, (payload->>'dry_run')::bool AS simulacao, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(payload->'regime') = 'object' THEN CASE WHEN (payload->'regime'->>'up')::bool THEN 'alta' ELSE 'baixa' END END AS regime, (payload->>'setups')::int AS setups, payload->>'stop_noise' AS ruido_d039, payload->>'research' AS analista, payload->>'opened' AS entradas, payload->>'exits' AS saidas, payload->>'rejected' AS recusas FROM events WHERE kind = 'decision.cycle' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: BTC vs EMA200 (%)
panels.description: Fechamento do BTC no candle de cada ciclo de decisão, acima (+) ou abaixo (−) da EMA200. Abaixo de zero, o filtro de regime (D-016) bloqueia todos os setups de compra.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, max((payload->'regime'->>'distance_pct')::float) AS distancia FROM events WHERE kind = 'decision.cycle' AND jsonb_typeof(payload->'regime') = 'object' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Setups e filtros por perfil
panels.description: Por perfil, no período: ciclos de decisão, setups encontrados, setups que só o filtro de stop no ruído (D-039) removeu, entradas abertas e ciclos com o regime em baixa (sem setup possível).

targets.rawSql: SELECT payload->>'profile' AS perfil, count(*) AS ciclos, sum((payload->>'setups')::int) AS setups, sum(jsonb_array_length(payload->'stop_noise')) AS ruido_d039, sum(jsonb_array_length(payload->'opened')) AS entradas, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->'regime'->>'up')::bool IS FALSE) AS ciclos_regime_baixa FROM events WHERE kind = 'decision.cycle' AND payload->'setups' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Viradas de regime
panels.description: Cada mudança do regime de mercado (BTC acima ou abaixo da EMA200), também enviada ao Telegram. A primeira leitura de cada timeframe só é registrada.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, payload->>'timeframe' AS timeframe, CASE WHEN (payload->>'up')::bool THEN 'alta' ELSE 'baixa' END AS regime, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(payload->'previous') <> 'boolean' THEN 'primeira leitura' WHEN (payload->>'previous')::bool THEN 'alta' ELSE 'baixa' END AS anterior, (payload->>'close')::float AS btc, (payload->>'ema_slow')::float AS ema200, (payload->>'distance_pct')::float AS distancia FROM events WHERE kind = 'market.regime_changed' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT a->>'asset' AS ativo, (a->>'sentiment')::float AS sentimento, (a->>'confidence')::float AS confianca, (a->>'veto')::bool AS veto, a->>'rationale' AS justificativa FROM research_reports r, jsonb_array_elements(r.view->'assets') a WHERE r.id = (SELECT max(id) FROM research_reports WHERE status = 'ok')
SELECT view->>'market_regime' AS regime, (view->>'exposure_multiplier')::float AS exposicao FROM research_reports WHERE id = (SELECT max(id) FROM research_reports WHERE status = 'ok')

panels.title: Custo diário do LLM
panels.description: Contabilidade em llm_usage: inclui estimativas de reservas expiradas e ajustes no dia UTC de origem. O custo no SigNoz usa apenas telemetria de respostas observadas e não inclui esses lançamentos; os totais podem divergir.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', at) AS time, sum(cost_usd)::float AS custo FROM llm_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok') AS ok, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS falhas FROM research_reports WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT source AS fonte, count(*) AS noticias, count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'critical') AS criticas FROM news_items WHERE $__timeFilter(published_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
